# `tools/gizmos/RopeGizmo.js`

> **Source:** `engine/tools/gizmos/RopeGizmo.js`

RopeGizmo - Visual handles for manipulating rope attachment points Features: - Draggable spheres at start/end attachment points - Catenary curve visualization between endpoints - Entity snapping when dragging near entities - Visual feedback for hover/drag states Based on common patterns from Unity/Unreal constraint gizmos: - Anchor points shown as spherical handles - Lines/curves connecting attachment points - Snapping to nearby entities for easy attachment
